
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Anik Biswas – E-Portfolio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500;12..96,700&family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;1,6..72,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#f2f5f7; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#14283b; --muted:#53677a; --line:#cfd9e1;
  --trace:#2f55d4; --event:#c8372d; --grid:#dfe6ec;
  --head:"Bricolage Grotesque","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;
  --body:"Newsreader",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);
  padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    color-scheme:dark;
    --bg:#0f1c29; --surface:#162637; --ink:#e6edf3; --muted:#9db0c0; --line:#2a3d50;
    --trace:#7fa0ff; --event:#ff7a6e; --grid:#1b2d3f;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  color-scheme:dark;
  --bg:#0f1c29; --surface:#162637; --ink:#e6edf3; --muted:#9db0c0; --line:#2a3d50;
  --trace:#7fa0ff; --event:#ff7a6e; --grid:#1b2d3f;
}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:1.125rem;line-height:1.65}
a{color:inherit}
a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--trace);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}

nav{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:20px 0;font-family:var(--head);font-weight:500;font-size:.95rem}
nav a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--muted)}
nav a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
nav .brand{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;margin-right:auto}

.hero{padding:32px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:210px 1fr 250px;gap:28px 36px;align-items:center}
.hvid{margin:0}
.hvid .introv{max-width:100%}
.hvid figcaption{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px;text-align:center}
.photo{margin:0}
.photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 78%,transparent);mask-image:linear-gradient(#000 78%,transparent)}
@media (max-width:900px){.hero{grid-template-columns:140px 1fr;align-items:start;gap:20px 16px}.photo{order:1;width:100%}.hvid{order:2;max-width:260px}.hero>div{order:3;grid-column:1/-1}}
h1{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6.5vw,4.6rem);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 20px}
.role{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.6vw,1.5rem);font-weight:500;margin:0 0 14px}
.lede{max-width:34em;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 28px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:500;font-size:1rem;text-decoration:none;padding:12px 20px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);border-radius:6px}
.btn.primary{background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--trace);border-color:var(--trace);color:#fff}

.trace{margin:44px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface)}
.trace svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:260px}
.trace .g{stroke:var(--grid);stroke-width:1}
.trace .line{fill:none;stroke:var(--trace);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-dasharray:3000;stroke-dashoffset:3000;animation:draw 3.2s ease-out .2s forwards}
.trace .ev{stroke:var(--event);stroke-width:1.2;stroke-dasharray:4 4}
.trace text{font-family:var(--head);font-size:12px;fill:var(--muted)}
.trace .evt{fill:var(--event)}
.cap{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);padding:10px 24px;max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto}
@keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.trace .line{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}html{scroll-behavior:auto}}

section{padding:56px 0 0}
.focus{margin-top:56px}
.vslot{aspect-ratio:16/9;max-width:560px;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:16px;font-family:var(--head);color:var(--muted)}
.pd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:24px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pd h4{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1rem;margin:0 0 4px}
.pd p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.pd .wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.steps{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:1.3em;color:var(--muted)}
.steps li{margin-bottom:6px;max-width:44em}
.introv{display:block;width:100%;max-width:300px;border-radius:10px;background:#000}
.vcap{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin:18px 0 0!important}
.project .wavev{max-height:380px;margin-top:8px}
.fgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.fgrid li{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:18px 20px}
.fgrid b{display:block;font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:4px}
.fgrid span{color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.places{margin-top:48px}
.ph{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.35rem;margin:0 0 16px}
.pgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.pgrid figure{margin:0}
.pgrid img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
.pgrid figcaption{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.pgrid figcaption b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:1rem}
.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:40px 0 0}
.facts li{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:16px 18px}
.facts b{display:block;font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.35rem;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.facts span{color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.sub{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-top:20px}
.sub a{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.9rem;text-decoration:none;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 14px;color:var(--muted)}
.sub a:hover{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-thickness:2px;text-decoration-color:var(--trace)}
nav .brand{text-decoration:none!important}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:200px 1fr;gap:16px 40px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:28px}
h2{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.35rem;font-weight:700;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.row p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:38em}
@media (max-width:720px){.row{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

dl{margin:0;display:grid;gap:22px}
dt{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:2px}
dd{margin:0;color:var(--muted);max-width:38em}

.project{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:28px}
.project h3{font-family:var(--head);font-size:1.5rem;margin:0 0 8px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.project ul,.list{margin:14px 0 0;padding-left:1.2em}
.project li,.list li{margin-bottom:6px;max-width:38em}
.projects{display:grid;gap:24px}
.project video{display:block;width:100%;max-height:420px;border-radius:8px;background:#000;margin-top:18px}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.gallery img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}
.gallery figcaption{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.gallery figure{margin:0}
.shot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:14px;margin:18px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.shot-grid figure{margin:0}.shot-grid img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px}.shot-grid figcaption{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
.shot{aspect-ratio:4/3;border:1.5px dashed var(--line);border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;padding:12px;font-family:var(--head);font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted)}
.single img{display:block;width:100%;border-radius:8px;margin-top:18px}
.tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:18px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.tags li{font-family:var(--head);font-size:.85rem;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:3px 12px;margin:0;color:var(--muted)}

.edu{display:grid;gap:22px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.edu li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;gap:4px 20px}
.eimg{display:block;width:100%;max-width:460px;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;margin-top:12px}
.edu .yr{font-family:var(--head);font-weight:500;color:var(--trace)}
.edu b{font-family:var(--head)}
.edu span.s{display:block;color:var(--muted)}
@media (max-width:520px){.edu li{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.contact a{font-family:var(--head);font-size:clamp(1.3rem,4vw,2rem);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.01em;word-break:break-word}
footer{margin-top:80px;padding:24px 0 32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--head);font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
</style>
</head>

    <h1>Anik Biswas</h1>
    <p class="role">EEE graduate specializing in telecommunications and fiber optic networks</p>
    <p class="lede">I want to work as a transmission engineer: someone who finds a fault in a fiber link, fixes it fast, and documents it clearly. I graduated from AIUB and I’m open to transmission and technical roles across Bangladesh.</p>

<figure class="hvid"><video class="introv" controls preload="metadata" playsinline poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64," aria-label="Introduction video of Anik Biswas"></video><figcaption>Watch my introduction</figcaption></figure>

<main class="wrap">
  <section id="about" data-view="home">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>About myself</h2>
      <div>
        <p>I’m a B.Sc. graduate in Electrical &amp; Electronic Engineering from American International University-Bangladesh, focused on telecommunications, fiber optic transmission and IP networking. My CGPA is 3.58.</p>
        <p>I enjoy the practical side of networks: measuring loss, tracing faults to their cause, and writing clear Reason for Outage reports. I’m disciplined, punctual and comfortable working in field conditions.</p>
        <p><b style="font-family:var(--head)">Highlights:</b> CGPA 3.58 in B.Sc. EEE, GPA 4.67 in HSC and 4.61 in SSC, active member of the IEEE AIUB Student Branch.</p>
        <p>I’m currently looking for a Transmission Engineer role where I can keep links reliable and grow into leading a technician team.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <div class="focus" data-view="home">
  <h2 class="ph">What I focus on</h2>
  <ul class="fgrid">
    <li><b>Fiber optic networks</b><span>Testing, splicing and fixing fiber links for home and business internet.</span></li>
    <li><b>Telecom and networking</b><span>Ethernet, IP networks and connecting backbone links to local points of presence.</span></li>
    <li><b>Hands-on projects</b><span>A transformer, an AM transmitter and a clap switch.</span></li>
  </ul>
</div>
  <div class="places" data-view="home">
    <h2 class="ph">Where I studied</h2>
    <ul class="pgrid">
      <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Entrance gate of Magura Government High School with a tree-lined path" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><figcaption><b>School</b>Magura Government High School</figcaption></figure></li>
      <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Main gate of Hossain Shaheed Suhrawardy College, Magura" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><figcaption><b>College</b>Hossain Shaheed Suhrawardy College</figcaption></figure></li>
      <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Aerial view of the university campus with its glass sphere building and football field" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><figcaption><b>University</b>American International University-Bangladesh</figcaption></figure></li>
    </ul>

        <div><dt>Fiber optic transmission</dt><dd>OTDR testing, optical power meter measurements, fiber splicing and patching, FTTH/FTTX operations, GPON, OLT and ONU management.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Networking</dt><dd>Ethernet and Layer-2, IP networking, backbone to PoP connectivity, and coordination with NTTN providers.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Operations and leadership</dt><dd>Supervising fiber technician teams, maintaining ODF, patch panel and link databases, commissioning and decommissioning links, fault diagnosis and RFO reporting.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Software</dt><dd>MS Office, MATLAB, AutoCAD (basics).</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Transferable skills</dt><dd>Problem-solving, clear communication, teamwork, fast learning and adaptability.</dd></div>
      </dl>

          <li><span class="yr">Graduate</span><div><b>B.Sc. in Electrical &amp; Electronic Engineering</b><span class="s">American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB) · Telecommunications · CGPA 3.58</span><img class="eimg" loading="lazy" alt="Aerial view of the university campus with its glass sphere building and football field" src="data:image/webp;base64,"></div></li>

      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

    <div class="row">
      <h2>Activities</h2>
      <dl>
        <div><dt>IEEE AIUB Student Branch</dt><dd>Active member. Attended technical seminars and workshops, followed technology trends and built connections with peers and professionals.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>AIUB Photography Club</dt><dd>Active member. Built creativity, observation and teamwork through group activities.</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Languages</dt><dd>Bengali (native), English (professional working proficiency), Hindi and Urdu (good).</dd></div>
      </dl>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="project-a" data-view="project-a">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Project A</h2>
      <div><article class="project">
        <h3>Single-Phase Step-Changing Transformer</h3>
        <p>A hands-on transformer project. It has a wound coil on a laminated core, a terminal block of wired connections, and a wooden base. The video walks around it from every side.</p>
        <video controls preload="metadata" playsinline poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64," aria-label="Walk-around video of the single-phase transformer"></video>
        <ul class="gallery" aria-label="Transformer photos">
          <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Front view of the transformer coil and frame on a wooden base" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><figcaption>Coil and frame</figcaption></figure></li>
          <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Side view showing the stacked laminated core" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><figcaption>Laminated core</figcaption></figure></li>
          <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Terminal block with blue wires connected" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><figcaption>Terminal block and wiring</figcaption></figure></li>
          <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="Transformer mounted on its wooden base" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"><figcaption>Mounted on its base</figcaption></figure></li>
        </ul>
        <ul class="tags" aria-label="Project areas"><li>Transformers</li><li>Electrical machines</li><li>Wiring</li></ul>
      
        <div class="pd">
          <div><h4>What it is</h4><p>A single-phase transformer with a wound coil, a laminated iron core and a terminal block with several wired connections, mounted on a wooden base.</p></div>
          <div><h4>My role and contributions</h4><p>I was the group head for this project. I led the group and made everything in it myself, from planning and building to testing.</p></div>
          <div class="wide"><h4>Process and decisions</h4><ol class="steps"><li>I planned a single-phase transformer whose output step can be changed by using different connections on a terminal block.</li><li>I used a laminated core made of stacked thin sheets, because it loses less energy to eddy currents than a solid block of iron.</li><li>I wound the coil on the core and brought the winding ends out to the terminal block, so the connections can be changed without touching the winding.</li><li>I mounted the transformer on a wooden base to keep it stable and safe to handle, then checked every connection.</li></ol></div>
        </div>
      </article></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="project-b" data-view="project-b">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Project B</h2>
      <div><article class="project single">
        <h3>AM Transmitter</h3>
        <p>A breadboard build of an AM transmitter, powered by two 9V batteries and fed from a small microphone. I checked the signal with an oscilloscope probe while testing.</p>
        <img loading="lazy" alt="AM transmitter circuit built on a breadboard with colored jumper wires, two 9V batteries, a microphone and an oscilloscope probe" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
        <p class="vcap">Oscilloscope trace of the AM wave from the transmitter:</p>
        <video class="wavev" controls preload="metadata" playsinline poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64," aria-label="Oscilloscope showing the AM transmitter wave"></video>
        <ul class="tags" aria-label="Project areas"><li>Analog communication</li><li>Circuit building</li><li>Oscilloscope testing</li></ul>
      
        <div class="pd">
          <div><h4>What it is</h4><p>An AM transmitter built on a breadboard with a microphone input, powered by two 9V batteries and checked with an oscilloscope.</p></div>
          <div><h4>My role and contributions</h4><p>I was the group head for this project. I led the group and made everything in it myself, from planning and building to testing.</p></div>
          <div class="wide"><h4>Process and decisions</h4><ol class="steps"><li>I split the design into simple blocks: a microphone for the sound input, a stage that makes the carrier signal, a stage that adds the sound onto the carrier (amplitude modulation), and the power supply.</li><li>I built it on a breadboard so I could change components quickly while adjusting the circuit.</li><li>I used two 9V batteries to give the circuit a steady supply.</li><li>I connected an oscilloscope to the output and adjusted the circuit while watching the wave.</li></ol></div>
          <div class="wide"><h4>Result</h4><p>The oscilloscope video above shows the wave produced by the transmitter.</p></div>
        </div>
      </article></div>
    </div>
  </section>
  <section id="project-c" data-view="project-c">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Project C</h2>
      <div><article class="project single">
        <h3>Clap Switch Using Transistors</h3>
        <p>A clap-activated switch built on a breadboard. A small microphone picks up the sound of a clap, and transistors switch an LED on. The circuit also has a buzzer and runs from a 9V battery.</p>
        <img loading="lazy" alt="Clap switch circuit on a breadboard with a microphone, resistors, a capacitor, transistors, a buzzer and an LED" src="data:image/webp;base64,">
        <p class="vcap">Demo: the LED lights up after a clap.</p>
        <video class="wavev" controls preload="metadata" playsinline poster="data:image/jpeg;base64," src="data:video/mp4;base64," aria-label="Clap switch demo video"></video>
        <ul class="tags" aria-label="Project areas"><li>Transistors</li><li>Analog circuits</li><li>Sound sensing</li></ul>
        <div class="pd">
          <div><h4>What it is</h4><p>A transistor-based clap switch with a microphone input, resistors, a capacitor, an LED and a buzzer on a breadboard.</p></div>
          <div><h4>My role and contributions</h4><p>I was the group head for this project. I led the group and made everything in it myself, from planning and building to testing.</p></div>
          <div class="wide"><h4>Process and decisions</h4><ol class="steps"><li>I used a small microphone to pick up the sound of a clap.</li><li>I used transistors to strengthen the weak microphone signal and switch the output on.</li><li>I added resistors and a capacitor to set the transistor operating levels, so a short clap is enough to trigger the switch.</li><li>I used an LED and a buzzer as outputs, built everything on a breadboard and powered it from a 9V battery.</li></ol></div>
          <div class="wide"><h4>Result</h4><p>The demo video above shows the LED switching on after a clap.</p></div>
        </div>
      </article></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section id="photography" data-view="photography">
    <div class="row">
      <h2>Photography</h2>
      <div>
        <p>Photography is my hobby, and I’m an active member of the AIUB Photography Club. I like shooting the natural side of Bangladesh: skies, big old trees and the changing light of the day.</p>
        <ul class="shot-grid" aria-label="Nature photo gallery">
          <li><figure><img loading="lazy" alt="A fiery sunset sky over city rooftops, with dark silhouettes of buildings below" src="data:image/webp;base64,"><figcaption>Sunset sky over the rooftops</figcaption></figure></li>

<script>
(function(){
  var pages=["home","resume","project-a","project-b","project-c","photography","contact"];
  var alias={about:"home",skills:"resume",courses:"resume",education:"resume",activities:"resume",project:"project-a",portfolio:"resume"};
  function show(){
    var h=(location.hash||"").replace("#","");
    var page=alias[h]||h;
    if(pages.indexOf(page)<0)page="home";
    var els=document.querySelectorAll("[data-view]");
    for(var i=0;i<els.length;i++)els[i].hidden=els[i].getAttribute("data-view")!==page;
    var links=document.querySelectorAll("nav a:not(.brand)");
    for(var j=0;j<links.length;j++){
      if(links[j].getAttribute("href")==="#"+page)links[j].setAttribute("aria-current","page");
      else links[j].removeAttribute("aria-current");
    }
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
  }
  window.addEventListener("hashchange",show);
  show();
})();
</script>
